description: Extension of VoiceWakeOverlayController providing session management, UI updates, and auto-send logic for voice wake overlay functionality.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Initializes and presents a new voice wake overlay session with given parameters.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns current session state info: token, source, text, visibility.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the current session with partial transcript, ensuring session token matches and session isn't final.

methods.name: presentFinal
methods.description: Displays final transcript, optionally auto-sends after delay, and updates session state.

methods.name: userBeganEditing
methods.description: Indicates user started editing, cancels auto-send and updates UI state.

methods.name: endEditing
methods.description: Ends editing mode without dismissing the overlay.

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates overlay with new text, reconstructs attributed string, and refreshes UI.

methods.name: beginSendUI
methods.description: Shows sending UI, optionally plays chime, and schedules dismissal after delay.

methods.name: requestSend
methods.description: Requests to send current session with a reason.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses overlay with animation, updates state, and calls relevant callbacks.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates voice activity level indicator if token matches and appropriate timing.

methods.name: evaluateToken
methods.description: Static method to compare active and incoming tokens for session validity.

methods.name: scheduleAutoSend
methods.description: Schedules automatic send after specified delay, handles cancellation and execution.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an attributed string from plain text with standard styling.
